language.note: The future poderão asks who can be, not who will be; the stem names no subject, the options supply it. dispensado de = excused from needing.

language.en: provided they are qualified to hunt
language.note: desde que = provided that: a condition on the group, not a second group.

nudge: The one exemption from the carta de caçador is for non-resident foreigners, and only desde que they are qualified to hunt in their own country. Enforcement officers, politicians and ICNF staff get none.

language.pt: além de outros requisitos, é ainda necessário
language.en: besides other requirements, it is also necessary
language.note: ainda here is 'also', not 'still' or 'yet': the stem asks for one more requirement on top of the others.
mais de = more than; the same form as mais de 6 meses in the dog licence question.

nudge: The extra requirement is age, mais de 16 anos. Citizenship and residence are not conditions: question 1 lets non-resident foreigners hunt here.

language.pt: que antecedem o final da sua validade
language.en: that precede the end of its validity
language.note: antecedem = come before: the window is the months before it runs out, not after.
caducidade is the lapse of validity; validade and caducidade point at the same end date, the number in front is what differs.

nudge: Renewal opens in the 12 months before the carta runs out. The number is the whole question; 18 and 24 are the distractors.

language.note: seu refers back to the carta, so 'its', not 'your' or 'his'.
A verb, from caducar: the carta ceases to be valid by itself. Not a noun, and nothing to do with deciduous.

nudge: A conviction for a crime de caça makes the carta caducar: it lapses outright. There is no correcting or swapping it.

language.note: respeitar a = to concern; nothing to do with respect.

language.pt: apenas é válida para algumas espécies
language.en: is only valid for some species
language.note: apenas = only, placed before the verb; it limits what follows.

nudge: A regional licence covers a region, the região cinegética a que respeita, with no species limit. Nobody, diplomats included, is exempt from the licença de caça (questions 8 and 9).
A hunting dog needs its own licence from mais de 6 meses, six months old. Pair it with the hunter's own age line in question 2: mais de 16 anos.

language.note: só = only, limiting the species; à/às after caçar marks what is hunted (caçar à perdiz, caçar aos coelhos).

nudge: One region, so a licença regional is enough, and the nacional covers it too. Snipe need no waterfowl licence: question 10 asks the same with rabbits and has the same answer.

language.en: carry out the act of hunting
language.note: venatório = of hunting, a formal adjective; o ato venatório is simply hunting.
for is the future subjunctive of ser after se: 'if they are', not the English 'for'.

nudge: Nunca: no one is excused the licença de caça, whatever their nationality or diplomatic status. The exemption in question 1 is from the carta de caçador, a different document.

language.note: ninguém = nobody; Portuguese needs no second negative with it here.

language.pt: desde que estejam habilitados a caçar
language.en: provided that they are qualified to hunt
language.note: desde que = provided that, followed by the subjunctive estejam.

nudge: The licença de caça has no exemptions: ninguém. The non-resident foreigner clause belongs to the carta de caçador (question 1), not to the licence.

language.note: só = only; no preposition this time (compare só às narcejas in question 7): caçar takes the species with or without à.

nudge: Rabbits in one region: a licença regional, or the nacional, is all that is needed. The waterfowl licence is only for aves aquáticas.
